recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-22494; any future attempt to further align Provenance.agent.type wording with the 2026 AuditEvent clarification should be handled under a separate Security WG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-22494 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Provenance. It requested aligning Provenance.agent.type with AuditEvent.agent.type by changing the binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/participation-role-type while retaining existing useful Provenance-specific codes.
initial_application: No explicit source commit mentioning FHIR-22494 was found. Current R5/R6 source history introduced source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml in 33b409a4b6d with Provenance.agent.type already bound to participation-role-type; the R4B draft in c69d71aa213d still used provenance-agent-type. Commit aa9defa3c842 then added the THO provenance-agent-type value set into participation-role-type alongside the AuditEvent DICOM source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Provenance and AuditEvent. Later Published issues FHIR-32519 and FHIR-32451 refined the same agent.type binding family by narrowing participation-role-type and making the agent.type binding Preferred; FHIR-32519 is already represented on the combined branch and updated Provenance.agent.type to preferred. FHIR-53882 later clarified AuditEvent.agent.type wording only, without changing the shared value set. The linked Zulip thread and Security WG minutes confirm that FHIR-22494's purpose was using the AuditEvent value set for Provenance.agent.type.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because current source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml binds Provenance.agent.type to participation-role-type, source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml binds AuditEvent.agent.type to the same value set, and source/terminologies/valueset-participation-role-type.xml includes both THO provenance-agent-type and DICOM CID 402.
